title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
summary: Robert Kiyosaki contrasts the money lessons of his own father with those of a friend's father, whom he calls his rich dad. He argues for financial education, owning assets and working for yourself rather than for a paycheck.
readIf: you want an easy, motivational introduction to thinking about money and assets.
skipIf: you need detailed, verifiable financial guidance rather than anecdotes and broad claims.
